title: Nasty Juice ASAP Grape 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: ASAP Grape 50/50 from Nasty Juice is an irresistible, syrupy-sweet black grape flavour combined with juicy forest berries and subtle dash of mint to provide a genuinely refreshing, exhale. As uplifting as it is delicious. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
